answer: A glacier VDF gate mints a marble per identity after a sequential time-lock, difficulty squaring per slot; the 100th clone needs 10,000 hours. Applicants lock a $20 nectar stake per slot tied to the epoch seed, then solve in series, each VDF proof committing to the one before. Three rotating auditors check proof and chain link in 24 hours; a broken link voids the marble, forfeits the chain's nectar, and freezes the rest for 10 epochs. 100 clones cost 338,350 hours, $676,700 at $2 an hour; 100 honest agents cost $200. One climber per thaw; a roped crowd waits in the cold.
